results.name: dense_cutlass_128x4_sanity
notes: Uses nvfp4_quantize with 128x4 scale layout and do_shuffle=False, the layout documented for cutlass mm_fp4.
Quantization error is expected; this check is mainly an interface and finite-output sanity test.
results.reference: bf16 matmul against the original unquantized tensors

results.name: g11_prepared_weight_cutlass_probe
notes: The real G11 tensors use FlashInfer/TRT-LLM prepared weights from prepare_static_weights_for_trtllm_fp4_moe.
This probe intentionally tests whether the prepared layout can be consumed by cutlass mm_fp4 directly.
A finite latency is not a correctness proof; the final custom kernel still needs a prepared-layout grouped GEMM/finalize implementation.
